adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~18 MAD N-shift from index ~560 to ~572, followed by a sharp return near 572–573. The residual after subtracting P1 (onset at 560) shows near-zero N residuals across the interval and clean return, confirming a genuine temporary platform. P2 extends to 573 but the return is abrupt and coincides with a data gap at 572–573; interior observations (561–571) are stable under P1, while P2’s extra day adds no persistent offset—suggesting P2 overextends. No independent permanent step is embedded. Thus only P1 is a complete genuine temporary platform.
